purpose.en: Build the hip flexors and front of the thigh.

text.zh: 膝盖微屈固定，腿向前抬起
text.en: Keep a soft, fixed knee and lift the leg forward

text.zh: 躯干不后仰，椅子只用来扶稳
text.en: Keep your trunk from leaning back; use the chair only for balance.

text.zh: 慢慢放回，不要锁死膝盖
text.en: Lower slowly without locking the knee.

commonErrors.en: Leaning back to help lift the leg.
Bending the knee into a march.

cautions.zh: 先做 1 组轻松的 6 次；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with one easy set of 6 reps, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 弹力带固定在身后牢固的低处
cautions.en: Anchor the band securely low behind you.
